blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Progressive neuronal loss is the hallmark of neurodegenerative disease, yet how loss of neurons shapes the pattern of cognitive decline remains poorly understood. Here we systematically ablate neurons (computational units) in language models spanning recurrent long short-term memory (LSTM) and Transformer architectures and apply limited fine-tuning as a simple proxy for compensatory plasticity. With whole-unit ablation, LSTMs degrade gradually with syntactic and semantic faculties declining in parallel across mild-to-moderate damage. By contrast, Transformers exhibit late threshold-like collapse under feedforward multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ablation and smoother sigmoid-like decline under attention-head ablation. Qualitatively, MLP-ablated models continue to make within-category semantic substitutions (semantic paraphasias) alongside rising non-responses, paralleling Wernicke-type aphasia, while attention-head ablation produces a trend toward loss of semantic specificity similar to the semantic variant of primary progressive aphasia (svPPA). These findings indicate that feedforward and attentional pathways have functionally distinct failure modes, suggesting that architecture-dependent failure profiles may offer new computational perspectives on aphasic syndromes and neurodegenerative diseases as an in silico model. Notably, early accuracy retention under Transformer attention-head ablation qualitatively parallels pre-symptomatic reserve before the 40--60% neuronal loss reported by Gomez-Isla et al. (1996) when clinical symptoms emerge in Alzheimer's disease, whereas the steadier LSTM decline parallels the symptomatic progression described by DeKosky and Scheff (1990) and Terry et al. (1991).
blocks.zh: 渐进神经丧失是神经退化性疾病的特征,然而神经元的丧失如何塑造认知衰减的规律仍然不甚了解. 在这里,我们系统地将语言模型中的神经元(computional units)分解为涵盖经常性长期内存(LSTM)和变形器架构,并应用有限的微调作为补偿可塑性的简单代名词. 随着整个单元的衰减,LSTMs逐渐退化,在轻度到中度的损伤中,综合和语义学系平行下降。 相比之下,变形器在feedward多层受体(MLP)的膨胀下显示晚阈值类似崩溃,在注意力头的膨胀下显示较平滑的sigmoid类衰减. 在定性上,MLP-blabed模型在不断上升的非反应的同时,继续制造类内语义替代(语义偏移),与Wernicke-type aphasia平行,而注意力头的blabed则产生类似初级进步phasia(svPPA)语义变体的语义特征丧失的趋势. 这些调查结果表明,向导和注意力路径在功能上有不同的故障模式,表明依赖架构的故障剖面可能作为硅模型,为厌氧综合征和神经退化性疾病提供新的计算视角。 值得注意的是,在Gomez-Isla等人(1996年)报告的40-60%神经丧失之前,在变形器注意力头瘤下及早保持准确性在质量上与症状前的储备相当,当时阿尔茨海默氏病出现临床症状,而较稳定的LSTM下降则与DeKosky和Scheff(1990年)和Terry等人(1991年)描述的症状发展相似。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Neurodegenerative diseases are characterised by the progressive loss of neurons in specific brain regions, producing architecture-dependent patterns of cognitive decline. For example, hippocampal damage in Alzheimer’s disease yields memory deficits, while anterior temporal damage in semantic dementia selectively dissolves conceptual knowledge ( Blennow et al., 2006 ; Hodges and Patterson, 2007 ) . Identifying the nature of such damage early is important because anti-amyloid drugs may be helpful in slowing disease progression in specific cases. Until recently, however, there were few ways to model neuronal dysfunction or loss because animal models lack language and no computational systems adequately modelled human language. Whether the pattern of language decline (which faculties survive, which erode gradually, and which collapse abruptly) can be predicted from damage to a computational architecture remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 神经元病的特点是特定脑区神经元逐渐丧失,产生依赖结构的认知衰减规律. 例如,阿尔茨海默氏症的河马损伤会产生记忆缺失,而语义性痴呆症的前期时间损伤有选择地溶解了概念知识(Blennow等人,2006年;Hodges和Patterson,2007年)。 及早确定这种损害的性质很重要,因为抗酰胺药物可能有助于减缓特定情况下的疾病发展。 然而直到最近,由于动物模型缺乏语言,没有计算系统充分模拟人类语言,模拟神经功能障碍或损失的方法很少. 语言衰落的规律(那些能存活下来,逐渐侵蚀,突然崩溃)是否能够从对计算结构的破坏中预测出来,仍然是一个有待解决的问题.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Summary of ablation: clinical parallel mapping across the ablation experiments. Silencing Transformer feedforward (MLP/FFN) neurons, Transformer attention heads, and whole LSTM hidden units produces distinct failure modes. These patterns parallel focal aphasic syndromes versus steady diffuse decline.
blocks.zh: 图1 萎缩概况:横跨萎缩实验的临床平行测绘. 静电变形器向前馈送(MLP/FFN)神经元,变形器的注意力头,以及整个LSTM隐藏单元产生明显的故障模式. 这些模式平行的焦头痛综合征与稳步扩散的下降。

blocks.en:
In artificial neural networks, pruning and ablation are well-studied tools for model compression ( Frankle and Carbin, 2019 ; Han et al., 2015 ) , and recent interpretability work has shown that individual neurons encode semantically meaningful features ( Olah et al., 2020 ; Geva et al., 2021 ) .
Moore et al. have demonstrated that progressive lesioning of CNNs produces visual deficits closely resembling posterior cortical atrophy ( Moore et al., 2023a ; Moore et al., 2023b ; Moore et al., 2025 ) . This motivates the central question underlying our paper: can progressive neuronal ablation in language models reveal architecture-dependent failure modes analogous to clinical aphasias, and can the resulting error patterns serve as a computational model for tracking early neurodegenerative decline before overall accuracy falls? 1 1 1 We use clinical terms as descriptive labels for error patterns; they do not imply that language models have cognition, comprehension, or disease.
blocks.zh:
在人工神经网络中,挤压和膨胀是研究良好的模型压缩工具(Frankle and Carbin, 2019;Han等人, 2015),近期的可解释性工作显示,单个神经元编码了精密有意义的特征(Olah等人, 2020;Geva等人, 2021).
摩尔等. 已经证明,CNN的逐渐损伤会产生与后皮质萎缩密切相关的视觉缺陷(Moore等人,2023a); Moore等人,2023b;Moore等人,2025年). 这激发了我们论文背后的核心问题: 语言模型中的渐进神经衰竭能否揭示出类似于临床麻痹的依赖架构的衰竭模式,由此产生的误差模式能否作为一个计算模型,在整体准确性下降之前跟踪早期神经衰减? 页:1 1 我们使用临床术语作为错误模式的描述性标签;它们并不意味着语言模型具有认知、理解或疾病。

blocks.en: Concurrent work has begun to apply this logic directly to language models. Yang et al. (2026) perturb a multimodal model (LLaVA 1.6) by injecting noise into a chosen layer. They then search the resulting parameter space for configurations that reproduce the naming-error profiles of 278 people with post-stroke aphasia on the Philadelphia Naming Test (PNT) 2 2 2 The Philadelphia Naming Test (PNT) ( Roach et al., 1996 ; Mirman et al., 2010 ) is a standard 175-item clinical picture-naming assessment for aphasia that classifies patient responses into seven categories: Correct, Semantic paraphasia (meaning-related error), Formal paraphasia (sound-alike error), Mixed (both meaning- and sound-related), Unrelated real word, Neologism (non-word string), and No-response (Supplement S8 ). , matching six of seven error categories. Wang et al. (2026) perturb functional components of Mixture-of-Experts and dense Transformers, identify components linked to Broca’s and Wernicke’s aphasia, and grade the resulting impairment using Western Aphasia Battery subtests. Both studies establish that perturbed language models can occupy clinically recognisable regions of behavioural space.
blocks.zh: 同时期的工作已经开始将这种逻辑直接应用于语言模型. 杨等. (2026)通过将噪声注射到选定的一层来扰动多式联运模型(LLaVA 1.6. 在费城命名测试(PNT) 2 2 费城 命名测试(PNT)(Roach等人,1996年;Mirman等人,2010年)是标准175项的临床图片命名评估,将患者反应分为七类:正确,语义偏移(意为相关误差),形式偏移(音同误差),混合(意与音同误差),不相关真词,Neologism(非字串),和无回应(补充S8),匹配七类误差中的六类. 王等编. (2026) Mixture-of-Experts和稠密变形器的扰动功能组件,识别与布罗卡和Wernicke的aphasia相连的组件,并使用西方的Aphasia电池子测试来分级由此产生的减值. 这两项研究都确定,扰动语言模型可以占据临床上可识别的行为空间区域.

blocks.en: Our study is complementary in three respects. First, rather than asking how much a network can be compressed while maintaining performance ( Frankle and Carbin, 2019 ; Han et al., 2015 ) or injecting Gaussian noise ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , we use neuronal ablation , the targeted, permanent destruction of individual computational units by zeroing all associated incoming and outgoing weights and biases and holding them at zero during subsequent fine-tuning. Thus, we model irreversible neuronal and synaptic loss alongside local compensatory plasticity ( Blennow et al., 2006 ; Moore et al., 2023a ; Moore et al., 2023b ) . Second, whereas Moore et al. ( Moore et al., 2023a ; Moore et al., 2023b ; Moore et al., 2025 ) track how progressive damage lowers overall accuracy to model a single syndrome, we track both the full decline curve across k ∈ [ 0 , 0.9 ] k\in[0,0.9] and how the mistakes themselves change (which words are missed and whether grammar or word meaning fails), allowing us to distinguish multiple failure modes. Third, rather than studying a single network architecture, we silence whole units across both recurrent LSTMs and Transformers, as well as between the word-storage (MLP) and context-gathering (attention) pathways inside Transformers (see Section 4 for exact weight-matrix definitions). We design metrics that allow us to compare how different architectures and pathways shape language decline, and to test whether early changes in error patterns can signal mild damage before overall accuracy drops.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究在三个方面是相辅相成的。 首先,我们不问一个网络在保持性能(Frankle and Carbin, 2019;Han等人, 2015)或注射高斯噪声(Yang等人, 2026)的同时可以压缩多少,而是使用神经衰竭,通过将所有相关的进出重量和偏差零化,并在随后的微调中将其保持为零,从而对单个计算单位进行定向和永久的破坏. 因此,我们将不可逆的神经元和突触性损失与局部的补偿性可塑性(Blennow等人,2006年;Moore等人,2023年a;Moore等人,2023年b)。 第二,而Moore等人则认为: (Moore等人,2023a); Moore et al., 2023b; Moore et al., 2025 )追踪渐进损害如何降低一个单一综合征模型的整体准确度,我们追踪跨越 k 的全衰减曲线[0, 0.9] k\in [0, 0.9] 以及错误本身如何变化(漏掉了哪些字以及语法或词义是否失败),让我们能够区分多个失败模式. 第三,我们不是研究单一的网络架构,而是在反复出现的LSTM和变形器之间,以及在变形器内部的词库(MLP)和上下文收集(意向)路径之间(确切的重量矩阵定义见第4节),使整个单元沉默. 我们设计了可以比较不同架构和路径如何塑造语言衰落的度量衡,并测试早期错误模式的变化能否在整体准确度下降之前发出轻微的破坏信号.

blocks.en: We evaluate this ablation protocol across four language model architectures of increasing scale and complexity (Table 1 ), from a small 10M-parameter LSTM ( Hochreiter and Schmidhuber, 1997 ) trained from scratch to Qwen 1.5-1.8B ( Bai et al., 2023 ) , a 1.8-billion-parameter pretrained Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们从一个小型的10M参数LSTM(Hochreiter和Schmidhuber,1997年)从零到Quen的1.5-1.8B,对四种规模和复杂性日益增大的语言模式架构(表1)进行这一扩展协议的评估。 (Bai等人,2023年),18亿参数的预训变形器(Vaswani等人,2017年).

blocks.en:
Our work makes the following contributions: 1. Architecture determines failure dynamics, not just severity. On a shared unit-removal footing, both the from-scratch Small LSTM and the pretrained AWD-LSTM degrade gradually on next-token accuracy from k = 0.1 k=0.1 without a buffered plateau (Figures 2 a,b). On the Cloze battery, their syntactic and semantic scores erode in parallel without dissociating from k = 0.1 k=0.1 onward, reaching the zero floor on content words across k = 0.4 k=0.4 – 0.6 0.6 as predictions fall back to common function words (Figure 5 , row 1). This steady co-decline parallels the broadly distributed symptomatic cognitive erosion of Alzheimer’s disease 3 3 3 While Alzheimer’s disease initially presents with a prolonged pre-symptomatic reserve phase followed by focal medial temporal deficits, its symptomatic phase progresses to broad, multi-domain cognitive decline. Our analogy to LSTM whole-unit ablation captures this second, syndromic dimension: multiple linguistic functions eroding gradually and in parallel without a selective syntactic–semantic split, in contrast to the focal pathway dissociations of Transformer sub-block ablation. ( Blennow et al., 2006 ) .
Pretrained Transformers behave differently. Under MLP neuron ablation, they lose accuracy at mild damage at about the same rate as the LSTMs (no early retention advantage). They then collapse abruptly across a critical threshold ( k ∗ ≈ 0.3 k^{*}\approx 0.3 – 0.4 0.4 , or 20 20 – 27 % 27\% of non-embedding parameters removed; Figures 2 c,e; Supplementary Figure 9 ; Supplement S2 ). By contrast, attention-head ablation loses less accuracy across mild-to-moderate damage ( k = 0.1 k=0.1 – 0.3 0.3 ) before declining across k = 0.4 k=0.4 – 0.7 0.7 (Figures 2 d,f), and on the Cloze battery it preserves substantially higher grammatical and semantic scores than MLP or LSTM unit removal through k = 0.5 k=0.5 (Figure 5 , rows 2–3). 2. Diagnostic metrics that distinguish architectures beyond raw accuracy. Two models can have the same overall accuracy yet fail on very different words, so we pair two diagnostic tools to measure how damage reshapes predictions at matched accuracy. First, we introduce a vocabulary moment ratio ( R 4 R_{4} ) and Jensen–Shannon divergence benchmarked against an accuracy-matched random-failure baseline (null model; Section 2.3 ; Figures 3 – 4 ). Rather than failing at random on common function words such as “the” or “and,” every ablated model continues to get the most common words right and makes its new mistakes on less common content words. Moreover, for a given drop in overall accuracy, this shift toward missing rarer words is much stronger under Transformer ablation than under LSTM unit removal (Figure 4 ; Supplement S3 ). Second, we use a quantified 100-prompt Cloze test that scores grammatical part-of-speech match alongside semantic word similarity, separating architectures where grammar and meaning erode together (LSTMs) from those where specific pathways diverge (Transformers; Sections 2.4 – 2.5 ; Figure 5 ). Because these non-random error shifts appear even at mild damage ( k = 0.1 ​ – ​ 0.2 k=0.1\text{--}0.2 ) before overall accuracy collapses, applying a similar accuracy-matched comparison to patient responses may be helpful in distinguishing early neurodegeneration from benign lapses (Section 3 ). 3. Pathway-dependent linguistic failure profiles. Feedforward (MLP) ablation and attention-head ablation in Transformers produce distinct degradation trajectories and directional error-profile differences that partially parallel the clinical distinction between Wernicke-type aphasia and the semantic variant of primary progressive aphasia (svPPA), respectively ( Wernicke, 1874 ; Gorno-Tempini et al., 2011 ) (Figure 1 ; Table 3 ). 4 4 4 Cloze tests ( Taylor, 1953 ) are fill-in-the-blank sentence-completion tasks that can separate syntactic competence (producing grammatically well-formed sequences) from semantic competence (selecting contextually appropriate word meanings). Clinical aphasiology has long recognised that these faculties can be independently disrupted: Wernicke’s aphasia, caused by posterior temporal lesions, produces fluent but semantically empty speech ( Wernicke, 1874 ) , while Broca’s aphasia disrupts syntactic production ( Broca, 1861 ) . MLP ablation drives a steep threshold collapse of both Cloze metrics while keeping semantic paraphasias at the intact rate and raising no-responses, whereas attention-head ablation preserves far greater Cloze competence through nominal k = 0.5 k=0.5 , where half as many non-embedding weights are zeroed as in MLP removal (Figure 5 , rows 2–3; Tables 2 and 4 ). Attention-head ablation also shifts null-corrected R 4 R_{4} less than MLP ablation (Figure 4 ) and shows a non-significant directional trend toward more generic substitutions (Section 2.5 ). In contrast to both Transformer pathways, LSTM whole-unit ablation erodes grammar and meaning together without a selective split (paralleling diffuse AD-type decline), and on the Philadelphia Naming Test (PNT) taxonomy only the larger ablated Transformers (not the LSTMs) match the overall accuracy and word-error range of post-stroke aphasia patients (Section 2.5 ; Figures 1 and 6 ; Table 3 ; Supplementary Table 20 ).

预先训练的变形器行为不同. 在MLP神经元萎缩下,它们以与LSTMs(没有早期保留优势)大约相同的速度在轻微损伤时失去精度. 然后,它们突然跨越临界阈值(k * + 0.3 k = 0.3 = 0.4 0.4,或20 20 = 27% = 27 = 排除非嵌入参数; 图2 c,e; 补充图9; 补充S2 ) 。 相比之下,在轻度至中度损害(k=0.1 k=0.1 – 0.1 – 0.3 – 0.3 )中,注意力头膨胀的精度降低,然后在K=0.4 k=0.4 – 0.7(图2 d,f)之间下降,在克洛泽电池上,它通过k=0.5 k=0.5 (图5,第2-3行)保存了比MLP或LSTM单位清除高得多的语法和语义分数. 2. 区分结构超出原始精确度的诊断指标。 两种模型可以具有相同的整体精度,但在非常不同的单词上却失败了,所以我们配对了两种诊断工具来测量损害如何以相应的精度重塑预测. 首先,我们引入了一个词汇瞬间比(R 4 R_{4})和Jensen–Shannon差异比以精确度匹配的随机故障基准(null模型;第2.3节;图3–4)作为基准。 而不是随意不使用“the”或“and”等共同功能词,而是继续纠正最常见的词,在不太常见的内容词上犯新的错误。 此外,对于总体准确度的下降,在变形器减速下,这种向稀有字的转变比在LSTM单位去除下更为强烈(图4;补编S3)。 其次,我们使用量化的100时速Cloze测试,在语义词相似性的同时对语法部分匹配进行评分,将语法和含义共同侵蚀的架构(LSTM)与具体路径不一致的架构(Transformers;2.4–2.5节;图5)区分开来. 因为这些非随机误差在整体准确度崩溃之前甚至会在轻度损伤(k=0.1–0.2 k=0.1\text{-}0.2)时出现,因此对病人的反应采用类似的精度比照比较,可能有助于区分早期神经衰变与良性失误(第3节). 3. 路径依赖语言故障简介。 变形器中的FeedForward(MLP)膨胀和注意力-头部膨胀产生明显的降解轨迹和方向误差,这与Wernicke-type aphasia(svPPA)的临床区别(Wernicke,1874年;Gorno-Tempini等人,2011年)(图1;表3) 4 4 Cloze测试(Taylor,1953年) 4 4 4 Cloze测试(Taylor,1953年)是填充式的句子-完成式任务,可以将合成能力(生成语法上完备的序列)与语义能力(选择上下文上适当的词义)区分开来. 临床药理学早已认识到这些院系可能独立中断: Wernicke的嗜血症是由后期时间损伤引起的, 产生流利但精致的空话(Wernicke, 1874年), 而Broca的嗜血症干扰了综合生产(Broca, 1861年). MLP膨胀使两种克洛兹度量衡都出现了陡峭的阈值崩溃,同时使语义偏振药保持完好的速度,并且提高了无反应率,而注意力头的膨胀通过名义k=0.5k=0.5k=0.5来保留了更大的克洛兹能力,其中非嵌入式重量比MLP的去除量低一半(图5,第2至3行;表2和表4)。 注意头偏移也比MLP偏移(图4)小于无修正的R 4 R_{4},并显示出非重大的方向性趋势,更通用的替代(第2.5节)。 与 " 变形器 " 路径形成对照的是, " 变形器 " 整体单位衰减侵蚀了语法和意义,没有选择性的分裂(平行的分散AD型衰减),在费城命名测试分类法中,只有较大的减速变形器(而不是 " 变形器 " )符合中风后麻痹患者的总体准确度和文字误差范围(第2.5节;图1和图6;表3;补充表20)。

Architecture determines failure dynamics, not just severity. On a shared unit-removal footing, both the from-scratch Small LSTM and the pretrained AWD-LSTM degrade gradually on next-token accuracy from k = 0.1 k=0.1 without a buffered plateau (Figures 2 a,b). On the Cloze battery, their syntactic and semantic scores erode in parallel without dissociating from k = 0.1 k=0.1 onward, reaching the zero floor on content words across k = 0.4 k=0.4 – 0.6 0.6 as predictions fall back to common function words (Figure 5 , row 1). This steady co-decline parallels the broadly distributed symptomatic cognitive erosion of Alzheimer’s disease 3 3 3 While Alzheimer’s disease initially presents with a prolonged pre-symptomatic reserve phase followed by focal medial temporal deficits, its symptomatic phase progresses to broad, multi-domain cognitive decline. Our analogy to LSTM whole-unit ablation captures this second, syndromic dimension: multiple linguistic functions eroding gradually and in parallel without a selective syntactic–semantic split, in contrast to the focal pathway dissociations of Transformer sub-block ablation. ( Blennow et al., 2006 ) .
Pretrained Transformers behave differently. Under MLP neuron ablation, they lose accuracy at mild damage at about the same rate as the LSTMs (no early retention advantage). They then collapse abruptly across a critical threshold ( k ∗ ≈ 0.3 k^{*}\approx 0.3 – 0.4 0.4 , or 20 20 – 27 % 27\% of non-embedding parameters removed; Figures 2 c,e; Supplementary Figure 9 ; Supplement S2 ). By contrast, attention-head ablation loses less accuracy across mild-to-moderate damage ( k = 0.1 k=0.1 – 0.3 0.3 ) before declining across k = 0.4 k=0.4 – 0.7 0.7 (Figures 2 d,f), and on the Cloze battery it preserves substantially higher grammatical and semantic scores than MLP or LSTM unit removal through k = 0.5 k=0.5 (Figure 5 , rows 2–3).
blocks.zh:
结构决定了失败动态,而不仅仅是严重性. 在共同单位清除的基础上,从小LSTM和经过预先训练的AWD-LSTM在没有缓冲高原的情况下,从k=0.1k=0.1的下位精度逐渐降解(图2a,b)。 在克洛泽电池上,他们的合成和语义分数平行侵蚀,而不从k=0.1k=0.1向上分解,在内容词上达到零底,横跨k=0.4k=0.4 – 0.6 – 随着预测回落到常见函数词(图5,第1行). 这一稳定的共解线与阿尔茨海默氏症广泛分布的症状认知侵蚀平行 3 3 而阿尔茨海默氏症最初呈现出一个长期的症状前保留阶段,然后是焦质间隙时间缺失,其症状阶段逐渐发展到广泛、多领域认知衰退。 我们对 LSTM 整体单位衰减的类比捕捉了第二个现象:多种语言功能逐渐平行地侵蚀,而没有选择性的合成-语义分裂,与变形器子块衰减的焦距脱节形成对比。 (Blennow等人,2006年).
预先训练的变形器行为不同. 在MLP神经元萎缩下,它们以与LSTMs(没有早期保留优势)大约相同的速度在轻微损伤时失去精度. 然后,它们突然跨越临界阈值(k * + 0.3 k = 0.3 = 0.4 0.4,或20 20 = 27% = 27 = 排除非嵌入参数; 图2 c,e; 补充图9; 补充S2 ) 。 相比之下,在轻度至中度损害(k=0.1 k=0.1 – 0.1 – 0.3 – 0.3 )中,注意力头膨胀的精度降低,然后在K=0.4 k=0.4 – 0.7(图2 d,f)之间下降,在克洛泽电池上,它通过k=0.5 k=0.5 (图5,第2-3行)保存了比MLP或LSTM单位清除高得多的语法和语义分数.

blocks.en: Diagnostic metrics that distinguish architectures beyond raw accuracy. Two models can have the same overall accuracy yet fail on very different words, so we pair two diagnostic tools to measure how damage reshapes predictions at matched accuracy. First, we introduce a vocabulary moment ratio ( R 4 R_{4} ) and Jensen–Shannon divergence benchmarked against an accuracy-matched random-failure baseline (null model; Section 2.3 ; Figures 3 – 4 ). Rather than failing at random on common function words such as “the” or “and,” every ablated model continues to get the most common words right and makes its new mistakes on less common content words. Moreover, for a given drop in overall accuracy, this shift toward missing rarer words is much stronger under Transformer ablation than under LSTM unit removal (Figure 4 ; Supplement S3 ). Second, we use a quantified 100-prompt Cloze test that scores grammatical part-of-speech match alongside semantic word similarity, separating architectures where grammar and meaning erode together (LSTMs) from those where specific pathways diverge (Transformers; Sections 2.4 – 2.5 ; Figure 5 ). Because these non-random error shifts appear even at mild damage ( k = 0.1 ​ – ​ 0.2 k=0.1\text{--}0.2 ) before overall accuracy collapses, applying a similar accuracy-matched comparison to patient responses may be helpful in distinguishing early neurodegeneration from benign lapses (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 诊断性衡量标准,可以区分超出原始精确度的架构. 两种模型可以具有相同的整体精度,但在非常不同的单词上却失败了,所以我们配对了两种诊断工具来测量损害如何以相应的精度重塑预测. 首先,我们引入了一个词汇瞬间比(R 4 R_{4})和Jensen–Shannon差异比以精确度匹配的随机故障基准(null模型;第2.3节;图3–4)作为基准。 而不是随意不使用“the”或“and”等共同功能词,而是继续纠正最常见的词,在不太常见的内容词上犯新的错误。 此外,对于总体准确度的下降,在变形器减速下,这种向稀有字的转变比在LSTM单位去除下更为强烈(图4;补编S3)。 其次,我们使用量化的100时速Cloze测试,在语义词相似性的同时对语法部分匹配进行评分,将语法和含义共同侵蚀的架构(LSTM)与具体路径不一致的架构(Transformers;2.4–2.5节;图5)区分开来. 因为这些非随机误差在整体准确度崩溃之前甚至会在轻度损伤(k=0.1–0.2 k=0.1\text{-}0.2)时出现,因此对病人的反应采用类似的精度比照比较,可能有助于区分早期神经衰变与良性失误(第3节).

blocks.en: Pathway-dependent linguistic failure profiles. Feedforward (MLP) ablation and attention-head ablation in Transformers produce distinct degradation trajectories and directional error-profile differences that partially parallel the clinical distinction between Wernicke-type aphasia and the semantic variant of primary progressive aphasia (svPPA), respectively ( Wernicke, 1874 ; Gorno-Tempini et al., 2011 ) (Figure 1 ; Table 3 ). 4 4 4 Cloze tests ( Taylor, 1953 ) are fill-in-the-blank sentence-completion tasks that can separate syntactic competence (producing grammatically well-formed sequences) from semantic competence (selecting contextually appropriate word meanings). Clinical aphasiology has long recognised that these faculties can be independently disrupted: Wernicke’s aphasia, caused by posterior temporal lesions, produces fluent but semantically empty speech ( Wernicke, 1874 ) , while Broca’s aphasia disrupts syntactic production ( Broca, 1861 ) . MLP ablation drives a steep threshold collapse of both Cloze metrics while keeping semantic paraphasias at the intact rate and raising no-responses, whereas attention-head ablation preserves far greater Cloze competence through nominal k = 0.5 k=0.5 , where half as many non-embedding weights are zeroed as in MLP removal (Figure 5 , rows 2–3; Tables 2 and 4 ). Attention-head ablation also shifts null-corrected R 4 R_{4} less than MLP ablation (Figure 4 ) and shows a non-significant directional trend toward more generic substitutions (Section 2.5 ). In contrast to both Transformer pathways, LSTM whole-unit ablation erodes grammar and meaning together without a selective split (paralleling diffuse AD-type decline), and on the Philadelphia Naming Test (PNT) taxonomy only the larger ablated Transformers (not the LSTMs) match the overall accuracy and word-error range of post-stroke aphasia patients (Section 2.5 ; Figures 1 and 6 ; Table 3 ; Supplementary Table 20 ).
blocks.zh: 路径依赖语言故障简介. 变形器中的FeedForward(MLP)膨胀和注意力-头部膨胀产生明显的降解轨迹和方向误差,这与Wernicke-type aphasia(svPPA)的临床区别(Wernicke,1874年;Gorno-Tempini等人,2011年)(图1;表3) 4 4 Cloze测试(Taylor,1953年) 4 4 4 Cloze测试(Taylor,1953年)是填充式的句子-完成式任务,可以将合成能力(生成语法上完备的序列)与语义能力(选择上下文上适当的词义)区分开来. 临床药理学早已认识到这些院系可能独立中断: Wernicke的嗜血症是由后期时间损伤引起的, 产生流利但精致的空话(Wernicke, 1874年), 而Broca的嗜血症干扰了综合生产(Broca, 1861年). MLP膨胀使两种克洛兹度量衡都出现了陡峭的阈值崩溃,同时使语义偏振药保持完好的速度,并且提高了无反应率,而注意力头的膨胀通过名义k=0.5k=0.5k=0.5来保留了更大的克洛兹能力,其中非嵌入式重量比MLP的去除量低一半(图5,第2至3行;表2和表4)。 注意头偏移也比MLP偏移(图4)小于无修正的R 4 R_{4},并显示出非重大的方向性趋势,更通用的替代(第2.5节)。 与 " 变形器 " 路径形成对照的是, " 变形器 " 整体单位衰减侵蚀了语法和意义,没有选择性的分裂(平行的分散AD型衰减),在费城命名测试分类法中,只有较大的减速变形器(而不是 " 变形器 " )符合中风后麻痹患者的总体准确度和文字误差范围(第2.5节;图1和图6;表3;补充表20)。

blocks.en: In short, these three contributions build on one another. How a network is wired determines whether its overall accuracy fades gradually or collapses at a threshold (Contribution 1). Our diagnostic metrics ( R 4 R_{4} with an accuracy-matched null model and the quantified Cloze test) look beyond overall accuracy to measure which words and linguistic skills fail (Contribution 2). Finally, applying those same metrics to specific pathways distinguishes word-storage (MLP) from context-gathering (attention) damage in Transformers, and contrasts both with diffuse LSTM decline, in ways that parallel clinical aphasias and dementia (Contribution 3; Figure 1 and Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 简言之,这三项贡献是相辅相成的。 网络是如何被线化的,决定其整体精度是逐渐淡出,还是在一个阈值(贡献1)下崩溃. 我们的诊断度量(R 4 R_{4},精度匹配的无效模型和量化的Cloze测试)超越了整体精确度,以衡量哪些词汇和语言技能失败(贡献2). 最后,在具体路径中采用同样的衡量标准,可以区分变形器中的词库(MLP)和上下文收集(意向)损害,与扩散的LSTM下降形成对比,其方式与临床麻醉症和痴呆症平行(贡献3;图1和表3)。

blocks.en: 2 Results
blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Architectures and Ablation Protocols
blocks.zh: 2.1 建筑和损害议定书

blocks.en:
We evaluate four autoregressive language models across two architecture families (Table 1 ; Supplementary Table 5 ): two recurrent networks, a Small LSTM trained from scratch and a pretrained AWD-LSTM ( Merity et al., 2017 ; Merity et al., 2018 ; Howard and Ruder, 2018 ) , and two pretrained Transformers, Qwen 0.5B and Qwen 1.8B ( Bai et al., 2023 ) (base training and pretraining details in Supplement S1 ).
To compare these architectures on equal footing, we apply a standardised unit-level ablation protocol that completely silences (fixes the output to 0 0 ) a fraction k ∈ [ 0 , 0.9 ] k\in[0,0.9] of computational units per layer across all layers. In the Small LSTM and AWD-LSTM, we remove whole recurrent hidden units , zeroing all incoming input and recurrent connections, gate biases, and outgoing connections to the next layer. In Qwen 0.5B and Qwen 1.8B, we remove either feedforward (MLP) intermediate neurons or attention heads . This design isolates architectural pathway properties from confounds of model size or lesion granularity, allowing us to compare degradation both as a function of k k and against the fraction of non-embedding parameters removed (see Methods, Section 4 , and Supplementary Figure 9 for details).
blocks.zh:
我们评估两个建筑家族的4个自动递归语言模型(表1;补充表5):两个经常性网络,一个从零开始培训的小型LSTM和一个经过培训的AWD-LSTM(Merity等人,2017年;Merity等人,2018年;Howard和Ruder,2018年),以及两个经过培训的网络。 变形器,Quen 0.5B和Quen 1.8B(Bai等人,2023年)(补充S1中的基础培训和预训细节).
为了在平等的基础上比较这些架构,我们应用了一个标准化的单位级衰减协议,将每层计算单位的分数KQ[0,0.9] k\in[0,0.9]完全沉默(将输出固定为0 ). 在小 LSTM 和 AWD- LSTM 中, 我们删除整个经常隐藏单元, 将所有输入和经常连接, 门偏差, 以及向下一层的输出连接 。 在 Quen 0.5B 和 Quen 1.8B 中,我们要么去除向导(MLP)中间神经元,要么去除注意头. 这一设计将建筑路径特性与模型大小或损伤颗粒性混杂在一起,使我们能够将降解作为kk的函数和去除的非嵌入参数的一小部分进行比较(详情见方法,第4节和补充图9)。

blocks.en:
Following ablation, all four models undergo a brief stochastic gradient descent (SGD) pass on TinyStories ( Eldan and Li, 2023 ) to simulate local compensatory plasticity while gradient hooks keep all ablated weights fixed at zero.
We then evaluate each ablated model on two complementary benchmarks (see Methods, Section 4 , for details): (i) held-out corpus next-word prediction to measure accuracy degradation and token-level error distributions (Sections 2.2 – 2.3 ), and (ii) a shared 100-prompt Cloze sentence-completion battery to disentangle syntactic, semantic, and clinical error profiles (Sections 2.4 – 2.5 ).
blocks.zh:
衰竭后,所有四个模型都经过一个短暂的斜度下降(SGD)通过TinyStories(Eldan和Li,2023年)来模拟局部的补偿性可塑性,而梯度悬钩则将所有减速重量固定在零.
然后,我们用两个补充基准(详情见《方法》第4节)来评价每个被删减的模型:(一) 用于衡量准确性退化和信物级误差分布的预言(第2.2至2.3节),以及(二) 一个共用的100倍速的Cloze句式补电池,以分解综合、语义和临床误差剖面(第2.4至2.5节)。

All models lose next-word prediction accuracy as the unit-ablation fraction k k increases from 0 0 to 0.9 0.9 , but the shape of the decline separates into three distinct regimes across architectures and pathways (Figure 2 ). 5 5 5 Full per-model accuracy numbers, curve-shape tests, and parameter-fraction scaling appear in Supplement S2 , Supplementary Tables 5 – 6 , and Supplementary Figure 9 . In both the Small LSTM and the pretrained AWD-LSTM, silencing whole hidden units produces a steady, near-monotonic decline in accuracy from k = 0.1 k=0.1 onward, with neither an early plateau nor a late collapse cliff, paralleling progressive, diffuse neurodegenerative decline (Figures 2 a,b).
Under MLP neuron removal, Qwen 0.5B and 1.8B initially lose accuracy across k = 0.1 k=0.1 – 0.3 0.3 at a pace comparable to the LSTMs (without an early plateau), but then undergo an abrupt threshold collapse across k ∗ ≈ 0.3 k^{*}\approx 0.3 – 0.4 0.4 , falling to near-zero accuracy by k = 0.5 k=0.5 – 0.6 0.6 (Figures 2 c,e).
By contrast, under attention-head removal, both Qwen models show early plateau-like buffering on the nominal- k k axis (retaining 96 96 – 98 % 98\% of baseline accuracy at k = 0.1 k=0.1 and flattening at 81 81 – 85 % 85\% across k = 0.2 k=0.2 – 0.3 0.3 ), followed by a broader S-shaped (sigmoid-like) decline across k = 0.4 k=0.4 – 0.7 0.7 (Figures 2 d,f).

blocks.en:
Aggregate accuracy curves (Section 2.2 ) track how many words a damaged model misses, but not which words fail, leaving open whether ablation degrades predictions uniformly across the vocabulary or selectively reshapes the error distribution.
To quantify this distinction, we introduce a vocabulary moment ratio ( R 4 R_{4} ) paired with an accuracy-matched random-failure null model that measures how ablation redistributes prediction errors across word-frequency ranks.
Using this framework, we show that neuronal ablation in every model redistributes errors non-randomly relative to random failure ( Δ ​ R 4 < 0 \Delta R_{4}<0 , Δ ​ D 1 > 0 \Delta D_{1}>0 ), with Transformer pathways, and particularly MLP ablation, producing larger null-corrected distributional shifts than LSTM whole-unit removal (Figures 3 – 4 ).
blocks.zh:
聚合精度曲线(第2.2节) 跟踪被损坏的模型漏掉的字数,但不记录哪些字数失败,留有解析是否在词汇中统一降解预测或有选择地重塑错误分布的空格.
为了量化这种区别,我们引入了一个词汇瞬间比(R 4 R_{4})与精度匹配的随机-失败无效模型对齐,该模型用来衡量衰减如何在词频序列中重新分配预测错误.
利用这个框架,我们显示每个模型中的神经衰竭会相对随机故障(QQ R 4 < 0\Delta R_{4}<0,QQ D 1 > 0\Delta D_{1}>0)进行非随机的再分配错误,其变形器路径,尤其是MLP衰竭,产生比LSTM整体单位清除(Figures 3– 4)更大的无修正分配转移.

Let 𝐞 ⁡ ( k ) = ( e 0 , e 1 , … , e C − 1 ) \mathbf{e}(k)=(e_{0},e_{1},\ldots,e_{C-1}) record how many times the model fails to predict each word i i in a vocabulary of C C tokens at ablation fraction k k , evaluated on the held-out WikiText-2 test set for the LSTMs and held-out TinyStories passages for the Qwen models (Methods, Section 4 ). Here, i i denotes the vocabulary index, ordered by word frequency (most common = 0 =0 ) for the LSTMs and by tokenizer merge order for Qwen, where common word pieces also have low indices.
We normalise 𝐞 \mathbf{e} to a probability distribution p i = e i / ∑ j e j p_{i}=e_{i}/\sum_{j}e_{j} and define the m m -th moment as: μ m ​ ( k ) = ∑ i = 0 C − 1 i m ⋅ p i ​ ( k ) . \mu_{m}(k)=\sum_{i=0}^{C-1}i^{m}\cdot p_{i}(k)\,. (1) The key diagnostic is the moment ratio : R 4 ​ ( k ) = μ 4 ​ ( k ) 1 / 4 μ 2 ​ ( k ) 1 / 2 . R_{4}(k)=\frac{\mu_{4}(k)^{1/4}}{\mu_{2}(k)^{1/2}}\,. (2) A single moment such as μ 1 \mu_{1} or μ 2 1 / 2 \mu_{2}^{1/2} only measures the average rank scale of errors, whereas the ratio R 4 = μ 4 1 / 4 / μ 2 1 / 2 R_{4}=\mu_{4}^{1/4}/\mu_{2}^{1/2} cancels out vocabulary scale to measure distribution shape (analogous to kurtosis, since R 2 = μ 2 1 / 2 / μ 2 1 / 2 ≡ 1 R_{2}=\mu_{2}^{1/2}/\mu_{2}^{1/2}\equiv 1 is trivial). Specifically, the denominator μ 2 1 / 2 \mu_{2}^{1/2} tracks the bulk error rank, while the i 4 i^{4} weighting makes the numerator μ 4 1 / 4 \mu_{4}^{1/4} sensitive to the high-index rare-word tail.
When errors are spread uniformly across a band of words [ 0 , K ] [0,K] , the bulk and tail scale together ( R 4 ≈ 1.158 R_{4}\approx 1.158 for any K K ; R 4 = 1 R_{4}=1 on a single word). By contrast, when most errors pile up near i ≈ 0 i\approx 0 (common words) alongside a rare-word tail at large i i , the mass near i ≈ 0 i\approx 0 pulls down μ 2 1 / 2 \mu_{2}^{1/2} while μ 4 1 / 4 \mu_{4}^{1/4} stays pinned by the tail, making R 4 R_{4} large ( 1.845 1.845 – 1.881 1.881 for a Zipfian distribution ( Zipf, 1949 ) p i ∝ 1 / ( i + 1 ) p_{i}\propto 1/(i+1) ).

In all three panels, the horizontal axis is surviving relative accuracy Acc ⁡ ( k ) / Acc ⁡ ( 0 ) \mathrm{Acc}(k)/\mathrm{Acc}(0) (from 1.0 1.0 at k = 0 k=0 on the left to 0.0 0.0 on the right), comparing models at equal accuracy loss. blocks.en: Across all six unit-level conditions, neuronal ablation fails non-randomly compared with the random-failure baseline ( Δ ​ R 4 < 0 \Delta R_{4}<0 , Figure 4 left; Δ ​ D 1 > 0 \Delta D_{1}>0 , centre; full tables and Fourier spectral analysis appear in Supplements S3 – S4 ). The reason is straightforward: in natural text, a handful of common words (such as the and and , near i ≈ 0 i\approx 0 ) make up a large share of all tokens, so randomly failing on previously correct predictions puts most new mistakes onto those very common words and drives R 4 null R_{4}^{\mathrm{null}} sharply upward. An ablated network, by contrast, still gets the most common function words right and instead makes its new mistakes on less common content words (ranks i i in the hundreds to thousands). As a result, its errors sit at higher word ranks ( Δ ​ R 4 < 0 \Delta R_{4}<0 ) and are spread across more distinct words ( Δ ​ D 1 > 0 \Delta D_{1}>0 ) than under random failure. In the LSTMs and Qwen MLP, Δ ​ R 4 \Delta R_{4} is already negative at 10 % 10\% damage ( k = 0.1 k=0.1 ), showing that non-random error shifts appear even at mild damage before overall accuracy collapses.
blocks.zh: 在所有6个单位级的条件中,神经衰竭与随机故障基线相比是非随机的(XQ R 4 < 0\Delta R_{4}<0,图4左方;XX D 1 > 0\Delta D_{1}>0,中心;全表和傅里叶光谱分析见补编S3–S4). 原因是直截了当的:在自然文字中,少数常见的单词(如和和,近i ≈ 0 i\约 0)占了所有符号的很大份额,因此随机不按先前的正确预测,将大多数新的错误放在这些非常常见的单词上,并驱动R 4 无效的 R_{4 }^{\ mathrm{ null}} ) 急剧向上. 相比之下,一个被淡化的网络仍然得到最常见的函数词正确,反而在不太常见的内容词上犯下了新的错误(排名i以百到千计). 因此,它的误差位于较高的单词排位(QQ R 4 < 0 \ Delta R_{4}<0),并且分布在比随机故障下更为明显的单词(QQ D 1 > 0 \ Delta D_{1}>0)之间. 在LSTMs和Quen MLP中,QQR 4\Delta R_{4}在10%的10\%破坏(k=0.1k=0.1)时已经是负数,表明非随机误差在整体精度崩溃前甚至会出现轻微损伤.

blocks.en: Figure 4 also reveals differences across pathways and architectures. Within the Transformers, MLP ablation shifts Δ ​ R 4 / R 4 ​ ( 0 ) \Delta R_{4}/R_{4}(0) more negatively than attention-head ablation when trials are pooled across k ∈ [ 0.1 , 0.4 ] k\in[0.1,0.4] (permutation p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} in Qwen 0.5B and p = 0.0238 p=0.0238 in Qwen 1.8B), though at a single matched accuracy level ( RelAcc = 0.80 \mathrm{RelAcc}=0.80 ) their confidence intervals overlap (Supplement S3 ). This pattern is consistent with the hypothesis that feedforward layers store word-specific associations ( Geva et al., 2021 ) whereas attention heads route broader context. Across architectures at equal surviving accuracy ( RelAcc = 0.80 \mathrm{RelAcc}=0.80 ), the overall shift from the undamaged error distribution ( JS ( p ( k ) ∥ p ( 0 ) ) \mathrm{JS}(p(k)\,\|\,p(0)) , Figure 4 right) is larger in the four Qwen curves than in the two LSTM whole-unit curves, and this difference remains after subtracting the random-failure baseline ( Δ ​ JS = JS obs − JS null \Delta\mathrm{JS}=\mathrm{JS}^{\mathrm{obs}}-\mathrm{JS}^{\mathrm{null}} of + 0.010 +0.010 to + 0.020 +0.020 in Qwen vs. + 0.002 +0.002 to + 0.003 +0.003 in the LSTMs; Supplement S3 ). Together, these results show that pairing the moment ratio and distributional metrics ( Δ ​ R 4 \Delta R_{4} , Δ ​ D 1 \Delta D_{1} , and Δ ​ JS \Delta\mathrm{JS} ) with an accuracy-matched random-failure null model separates non-random error concentration from simple accuracy loss, distinguishing targeted Transformer pathway damage from more uniform LSTM decline when accuracy scores alone cannot.
blocks.zh: 图4还显示了不同路径和结构之间的差异。 在变压器内部,MLP的减速转动XQR 4 / R 4(0)\Delta R_{4}/R_{4}(0)比注意力头减速转动更消极,因为试验被集合到k [0.1,0.4] k\in [0.1,0.4] (在Quen 0.5B中,p < 10 - 4 p < 10^{-4}在Quen 0.5B中,p = 0.0238 p= 0.0238 在Quen 1.8B中),尽管在单一的精确度上(RlAcc = 0.80\mathrm{RelAcc* 0.80),其置信间隔重叠(补充S3). 这种模式与以下假设是一致的,即:向导层存储特定词的关联(Geva等人,2021年),而注意力则领导更广泛的路由上下文。 在相同存活精度的架构中(RelAcc = 0.80\mathrm{RelAcc = 0.80),从未损坏的误差分布中的总体变化(JS (p (k)) → p (0)) → mathrm{JS}(p(k)\,\|\,p(0)),图4右),在四个Quen曲线中比两个LSTM全单元曲线大,这一差异在减去随机故障基线后仍然存在(XJS = JS obs – JS null\Delta\mathrm{JS}^{\mathrm{obs}}-\mathrm{JS}^{\mathrm{null}},+0.010+0.020+0.003 0.003,在LSTMs中是补充S3). 这些结果显示,将瞬间比例和分布度量(XΔ R 4\Delta R_{ 4},XΔ D 1\Delta D_{1})和XΔ JS\Delta\mathrm{JS}配对,精确度匹配随机故障的无效模型将非随机误差浓度与简单的精度损失区分开来,将目标变速器路径损害与更统一的LSTM下降区分开来,而当精度得分单是不能的.

blocks.en: 2.4 Quantified Cloze Test: Dissociating Syntax from Semantics
blocks.zh: 2.4 量化的服饰试验:从语义中分离语法

blocks.en: To test whether grammatical structure and word meaning degrade together or separate by pathway, as in clinical aphasia ( Goodglass, 1993 ) , we evaluate all models on a 100-prompt fill-in-the-blank sentence-completion (Cloze) battery (where each model predicts the missing final word of a sentence), stratified across nouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs. We measure syntactic accuracy by part-of-speech (POS) match rate and semantic relevance by GloVe ( Pennington et al., 2014 ) word-embedding cosine similarity to the target word. Because cosine similarity is set to zero whenever the predicted word is not tagged as a content word (Methods, Section 4 ), the two metrics are not fully independent.
blocks.zh: 为了测试语法结构和词的意义是一起降解还是通过路径分解,比如临床上aphasia(Goodglass,1993年),我们评价所有模型在一个100瞬间填充的句子-填充(Cloze)电池上(其中每个模型预测一个句子的漏掉的词),分层排列在名词,动词,形容词和副词上. 我们通过部分语调(POS)匹配率和语义相关性来测量合成精度,由GloVe(Pennington et al.,2014年)词-嵌合共振与目标词相似. 因为当预言的单词没有被标记为内容单词时(Methods, section 4 ),余弦相似性被设定为0,所以这两个度量标准并不完全独立.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Syntactic and semantic performance on the 100-prompt fill-in-the-blank (Cloze) test under progressive unit-level ablation. Each panel plots grammatical part-of-speech match rate (blue circles, syntax) and GloVe cosine similarity to the target word (red squares, semantics) on the vertical axis against the fraction of units removed k ∈ [ 0.0 , 0.9 ] k\in[0.0,0.9] on the horizontal axis (means ± 1 \pm 1 SE across trials; k = 0.0 k=0.0 is the undamaged model). Row 1: Under whole-unit removal in both the Small LSTM (left) and pretrained AWD-LSTM (right), syntax and semantics erode in parallel from k = 0.1 k=0.1 onward, reaching near zero at k = 0.4 k=0.4 and 0.0 % 0.0\% POS by k = 0.5 k=0.5 – 0.6 0.6 as outputs default to common function words. Rows 2–3: In both Qwen 0.5B and Qwen 1.8B, MLP neuron ablation (left) declines moderately through k = 0.3 k=0.3 before a steep threshold collapse across k ∗ ≈ 0.3 k^{*}\approx 0.3 – 0.4 0.4 (near zero by k = 0.5 k=0.5 – 0.6 0.6 ), whereas attention-head ablation (right) declines much more gradually on both metrics through k = 0.5 k=0.5 – 0.6 0.6 .

blocks.en:
Across architectures, the unit-level Cloze trajectories separate pathway-selective Transformer breakdown from non-dissociated LSTM decline (Figure 5 and Table 2 , with full per- k k curves in Supplement S5 and Supplementary Table 17 ).
In both Qwen Transformers (Figure 5 , rows 2–3), MLP neuron ablation retains moderate performance at mild damage before collapsing both syntax and semantics across k ∗ ≈ 0.3 k^{*}\approx 0.3 – 0.4 0.4 to near zero by k = 0.5 k=0.5 . Attention-head ablation declines much more gradually on the nominal- k k axis, retaining roughly 4.7 4.7 - to 7 7 -fold higher grammatical and semantic competence at nominal k = 0.5 k=0.5 (Supplement S5 ).
In both LSTMs under whole-unit removal (Figure 5 , row 1), syntax and semantics always erode in parallel without dissociating. Both Cloze metrics (POS match and cosine similarity) decline proportionally across k = 0.1 k=0.1 – 0.3 0.3 and reach the zero floor on content words across k = 0.4 k=0.4 – 0.6 0.6 , as cumulative unit loss across the serial 3-layer stack reduces predictions to common function words.
blocks.zh:
在整个架构中,单元级的Cloze轨迹将路径-选择性变压器与非分离的LSTM衰落分解(图5和表2,在补充S5和补充表17中包含完整的每千千曲线)。
在两个Quen变形器(图5,第2至第3行)中,MLP神经元衰竭在轻度损伤时保留中度性能,然后在语法和语义上崩溃,横跨 k * 0.3 k 大约 0.3 – 0.4 到 近 0 = k = 0.5 k = 0.5 。 在名义-k k 轴上,注意力头膨胀程度更逐步下降,在名义-k = 0.5 k= 0.5(补充S5)时,保留了大约4.7 - 7 - 7倍更高的语法和语义能力。
在全单位清除下的LSTMs(图5,第1行)中,语法和语义总是平行侵蚀,而不分离. Cloze 度量衡(POS匹配和同位素相似性)均在 k = 0.1 k = 0.1 – 0.3 – 0.3之间成比例递减,并在内容单词上达到零底值 横跨 k = 0.4 k = 0.4 – 0.6 – 6,因为跨序列 3 层堆栈的累积单位损耗会减少对常见函数单词的预测.

Transformer MLP and attention pathways diverge sharply at severe damage ( k = 0.5 k=0.5 ), whereas both LSTMs erode syntax and semantics in lockstep until reaching the content-word floor across k = 0.4 k=0.4 – 0.6 0.6 (means across trials; full trajectories appear in Supplement S5 and Supplementary Table 17 ).

blocks.en: 2.5 Clinical Parallel Assignments: Converging Evidence
blocks.zh: 2.5 临床平行任务:汇集证据

blocks.en: We test three hypotheses linking network architecture to clinical language disorders: (1) in Transformers, damaging the feedforward (MLP) layers disrupts word retrieval while leaving related-word mistakes intact, resembling Wernicke-type aphasia ; (2) damaging the attention heads preserves sentence structure across moderate damage while shifting wrong words toward more general terms, resembling semantic dementia (svPPA) ; and (3) in serial LSTMs, which lack separate pathways or skip connections, removing whole units erodes grammar and word meaning together, resembling diffuse Alzheimer’s-type (AD) decline .
blocks.zh: 我们测试了三个将网络架构与临床语言障碍联系起来的假设:(1) 在变形器中,破坏向导(MLP)层会破坏文字检索,同时使相关词错误保持原状,类似Wernicke型偏执症;(2) 破坏注意力头会保留句子结构,跨越中度损伤,同时将错误的词转移到更笼统的词中,类似语义性痴呆症(svPPA);(3) 在序列LSTM中,缺乏独立的路径或跳过连接,删除整个单元会侵蚀语法和词义,使阿尔茨海默症类型(AD)下降。

blocks.en: The four paragraphs below test these hypotheses by combining the damage curves from Sections 2.2 – 2.4 with the specific word mistakes each model makes at 20 % 20\% ablation (Tables 3 – 4 , building on the Cloze benchmarks in Table 2 ). The first two paragraphs examine the two Transformer pathways in turn, comparing MLP damage against Wernicke-type aphasia (Table 3 , rows 1–2; Table 4 ) and attention-head damage against svPPA (rows 3–4). The third paragraph contrasts both Transformer pathways with whole-unit removal in the two LSTMs, which parallels diffuse AD-type decline (rows 5–6). The fourth paragraph compares the mistake patterns of all undamaged and damaged models directly against clinical naming data from stroke patients with aphasia (Figure 6 ; Supplementary Table 20 ).
blocks.zh: 以下四段通过将第2.2节 - 2.4节中的损坏曲线与每个模型在20% 20% 的减速时产生的具体文字错误结合起来来检验这些假设(表3 - 4,基于表2中的克洛兹基准)。 前两段依次考察了两个变形器路径,比较了MLP损伤与Wernicke型aphasia(表3,第1–2行;表4)和SvPPA的注意力头损伤(第3–4行). 第三段将变形器路径与两个LSTM中全单位去除相对应,它们平行于分散的AD型衰减(第5-6行). 第四段将所有未受损和受损模型的错误模式直接与中风病人的贫血症临床命名数据进行比较(图6;补充表20)。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Clinical parallel synthesis across the six unit-level ablation conditions. Each condition is classified along two converging axes: quantitative degradation dynamics ( k ∈ [ 0 , 0.9 ] k\in[0,0.9] ) and qualitative Cloze error profiles at k = 0.2 k=0.2 (detailed error-type breakdowns appear in Table 4 , Figure 6 , and Supplements S6 and S8 ).
blocks.zh: 表3:临床平行合成6个单位级消化状况. 每个条件按照两个汇合轴进行分类:定量降解动力学(k ∈ [0, 0.9] k\in [0, 0.9])和定性克洛兹误差剖面,以k = 0.2 k=0.2(详细误差类型的细分见表4,图6,以及S6和S8补编)。

blocks.en:
Under MLP neuron ablation, both Qwen Transformers lose exact word-prediction accuracy and eventually collapse across k ∗ ≈ 0.3 ​ – ​ 0.4 k^{*}\approx 0.3\text{--}0.4 , yet at moderate damage ( k = 0.2 k=0.2 ) their wrong content-word guesses remain similar in specificity and concreteness to those of the undamaged model and preserve the undamaged rate of meaning-related word substitutions (semantic paraphasias: 11.7 % 11.7\% vs. 11.0 % 11.0\% undamaged in Qwen 1.8B). 7 7 7 Word specificity is measured using the human concreteness ratings of Brysbaert et al. (2014) ( 1 = abstract 1=\text{abstract} to 5 = concrete 5=\text{concrete} ), where MLP-ablated substitutions show no detectable drop in concreteness relative to the undamaged model. Meaning-related errors are scored under the Philadelphia Naming Test (PNT) taxonomy: MLP ablation preserves the undamaged semantic paraphasia rate ( 11.7 % 11.7\% vs. 11.0 % 11.0\% in Qwen 1.8B), which exceeds attention-head ablation ( 9.1 % 9.1\% ) because attention ablation slightly reduces semantic paraphasias. Examples cited in the text are absent from the undamaged model’s top-5 predictions; attribute changes such as “shallow” for “cold” are scored as unrelated rather than same-category semantic paraphasias under PNT rules (Supplements S6 – S8 ). For example, the MLP-damaged model replaces target words with other specific words from the same category (such as “bay” for “ocean” and “river” for “sea” ) or with related attributes (such as “shallow” for “cold” ).
This error pattern resembles Wernicke-type (receptive) aphasia after posterior temporal damage ( Wernicke, 1874 ; Goodglass, 1993 ) : in both cases, retrieving the exact target word fails, yet substitutions remain concrete, meaning-related words without a selective loss of grammar over meaning.
The parallel is partial because clinical Wernicke’s aphasia is fluent and elevates semantic paraphasias, whereas MLP ablation keeps semantic paraphasias at the undamaged rate while increasing blank and function-word outputs and lowering grammatical match. 8 8 8 In Table 2 , MLP ablation at k = 0.2 k=0.2 lowers Cloze grammatical POS match ( 64.0 % → 48.8 % 64.0\%\to 48.8\% in Qwen 1.8B; 65.0 % → 47.2 % 65.0\%\to 47.2\% in Qwen 0.5B) and semantic cosine similarity ( 0.663 → 0.449 0.663\to 0.449 ; 0.643 → 0.421 0.643\to 0.421 ) in parallel before collapsing at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ( 6.2 % ​ – ​ 6.4 % 6.2\%\text{--}6.4\% POS), while non-content outputs rise from 7.0 % ​ – ​ 9.0 % 7.0\%\text{--}9.0\% undamaged to 30.7 % ​ – ​ 34.8 % 30.7\%\text{--}34.8\% at k = 0.2 k=0.2 (Table 4 ). Overall, this pattern is consistent with Transformer MLP layers storing specific word meanings (Table 3 , rows 1–2; Tables 2 and 4 ; Figures 2 c,e, 4 – 6 ; Supplement S6 and Supplementary Tables 18 and 20 ).
blocks.zh:
在MLP神经元萎缩下,两个Quen变形器都失去准确的文字预测精度,最终在k* 0.3 – 0.4 k^{*}\约0.3\text{-}0.4 之间崩溃,然而在中度损伤(k = 0.2 k=0.2)时,其错误的内容词猜想仍然与未损坏模型的特异性和混凝土相似,并保持了与意义相关的词替代的未损坏率(语义偏移:11.7% 11.7\%=11.0% 11.0\%在Quen 1.8B 中未损坏). 7 7 字特异性使用Brysbaert等人(2014年)的人类混凝土评级(1 = 抽象 1=\text{abstract})测量,5 = 混凝土 5=\text{concrete},其中MLP-ablated替代物相对于未损坏模型显示混凝土没有可探测的下降. 意义相关误差在费城命名测试(PNT)分类法下得分: MLP衰减保留了未受损的语义偏振率(11.7% 11.7\%对11.0% 11.0\%在Quen 1.8B),超过了注意力头衰减(9.1% 9.1\%),因为注意力衰减略微减少了语义偏振率. 案文中引用的例子没有出现在未受损模型的前5名预测中;诸如“寒冷”的“shallow”等属性变化被评为与PNT规则(补充S6 – S8 )无关而非同类别的语义偏执症。 例如,MLP损坏模型将目标词替换为来自同一类别的其他具体词(如“海洋”的“bay”和“海洋”的“river”)或具有相关属性(如“寒”的“shallow”)。
这种错误模式类似于Wernicke-type(受体)在后期时间损害(Wernicke,1874年;Goodglass,1993年)之后的发作模式:在这两种情况下,检索准确的目标词失败,然而替换仍然是具体,意义相关的词,没有选择性地失去语法而不是意义.
其平行性是局部的,因为临床上的Wernicke的aphasia是流利的,可以提升语义上的parphasia,而MLP的blation则使语义上的parphasia保持无损的速度,同时增加空白和功能字的输出,降低语法上的匹配. 8 8 在表2中,MLP膨胀为k=0.2k=0.2下限。 cloze语法POS匹配(64.0% → 48.8% → 64.0= 48.8= 48.8= Qwen 1.8B;65.0% → 47.2% → 47.2= 47.2= Qwen 0.5B)和语素相似性(0.663= 0.449 0.663= 0.449= 0.449;0.643= 0.443= 0.421)在K= 0.5 k= 0.5 (6.2% – 6.4= 6.2= {}6.4= POS)崩溃前平行进行,非内容产出则从7.0% – 9.0= 7.0= text{ - }9.0= 未损坏到30.7= 34.8% 30.7= text{ -}34.8= k= 0.2 k= 0.2(表4)上升。 总的来说,这种模式符合变形器 MLP 层存储特定词义(表3,第1至2行;表2和4;图2c、e、4至6;补充S6和补充表18和20)。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Cloze error-type distribution and Brysbaert concreteness drop ( Δ ​ Conc. \Delta\text{Conc.} , target minus prediction ( Brysbaert et al., 2014 ) ; positive values indicate more abstract substitutions) for undamaged ( k = 0 k=0 ) and unit-ablated ( k = 0.2 k=0.2 ) models. MLP ablation lowers accuracy and raises non-content outputs while keeping substitution concreteness near the undamaged baseline, whereas attention ablation shifts substitutions toward more abstract words. For the ablated models, values show the mean and 95% confidence interval across 10 independent ablation trials (coding and exact-match details appear in Supplements S6 – S7 ).

blocks.en:
Under attention-head ablation, both Qwen Transformers lose performance much more gradually than under MLP ablation, retaining substantial grammatical and meaning-related Cloze competence even when 40 % ​ – ​ 50 % 40\%\text{--}50\% of attention heads are removed ( k = 0.4 ​ – ​ 0.5 k=0.4\text{--}0.5 ). 9 9 9 In Table 2 , attention-head ablation preserves high Cloze grammatical POS match and semantic cosine similarity at k = 0.2 k=0.2 ( 59.9 % 59.9\% and 0.606 0.606 in Qwen 1.8B; 52.2 % 52.2\% and 0.519 0.519 in Qwen 0.5B) and retains 42.0 % 42.0\% POS / 0.319 0.319 cosine (Qwen 1.8B) and 35.0 % 35.0\% POS / 0.198 0.198 cosine (Qwen 0.5B) at k = 0.5 k=0.5 , noting that k = 0.4 ​ – ​ 0.5 k=0.4\text{--}0.5 removes 12 % ​ – ​ 17 % 12\%\text{--}17\% of non-embedding weights because attention blocks contain half as many parameters as MLP blocks (Supplement S5 ). Yet when the attention-damaged model makes content-word mistakes at moderate damage ( k = 0.2 k=0.2 ), its guesses shift toward more general, abstract words than those of the undamaged model. 10 10 10 On the Brysbaert concreteness scale (Table 4 ), the shift toward more abstract substitutions ( Δ ​ Conc. \Delta\text{Conc.} ) at k = 0.2 k=0.2 is statistically significant relative to the undamaged model in Qwen 0.5B ( + 0.43 +0.43 vs. + 0.15 +0.15 undamaged) and borderline in Qwen 1.8B ( + 0.24 +0.24 vs. + 0.13 +0.13 undamaged; Supplement S6 ). For example, the attention-damaged model replaces specific words with broader or more generic terms (such as “small” for “gentle” in Qwen 1.8B and “good” for “clear” in Qwen 0.5B), alongside some same-domain substitutions (such as “desktop” for “keyboard” in Qwen 1.8B).
This combination of preserved sentence grammar and a drift from specific toward more general words resembles the semantic variant of primary progressive aphasia (svPPA, or semantic dementia) , in which anterior temporal atrophy erodes specific word knowledge into generic or superordinate terms while sparing syntax ( Warrington, 1975 ; Hodges and Patterson, 2007 ; Gorno-Tempini et al., 2011 ; Lambon Ralph et al., 2017 ) .
The parallel is partial because clinical svPPA involves a progressive, category-by-category loss of conceptual knowledge, and while attention and MLP ablation separate sharply in their overall Cloze curves across k = 0.3 ​ – ​ 0.5 k=0.3\text{--}0.5 , their difference in individual error types at k = 0.2 k=0.2 is a non-significant directional trend (see also Section 3 , Limitations; Table 3 , rows 3–4; Tables 2 and 4 ; Figure 5 , rows 2–3; Supplement S6 ).

blocks.en:
Silencing whole hidden units in either the Small LSTM or the pretrained AWD-LSTM produces a smooth, steady decline in next-word accuracy across k ∈ [ 0 , 0.9 ] k\in[0,0.9] (Figures 2 a,b).
Unlike the Transformers, the damaged LSTMs keep their mistakes spread across common and rare words in roughly the same proportions as the undamaged model (Figures 3 a,b and 4 ), and their grammatical and meaning-related Cloze scores decline together at every damage level without separating (Figure 5 , row 1). 11 11 11 In Table 2 and Supplementary Table 17 , whole-unit ablation lowers Cloze grammatical POS match and semantic cosine similarity in parallel across mild-to-moderate damage. In the AWD-LSTM, POS match and cosine similarity drop from 57.0 % 57.0\% and 0.450 0.450 undamaged to 42.7 % 42.7\% and 0.322 0.322 at k = 0.2 k=0.2 , 28.4 % 28.4\% and 0.203 0.203 at k = 0.3 k=0.3 , and 2.2 % 2.2\% and 0.020 0.020 at k = 0.5 k=0.5 . In the Small LSTM, they drop from 59.0 % 59.0\% and 0.337 0.337 undamaged to 23.6 % 23.6\% and 0.177 0.177 at k = 0.2 k=0.2 , 11.4 % 11.4\% and 0.073 0.073 at k = 0.3 k=0.3 , and 0.0 % 0.0\% and 0.000 0.000 at k = 0.5 k=0.5 . Across mild-to-moderate damage ( k ≤ 0.2 ​ – ​ 0.3 k\leq 0.2\text{--}0.3 ), this steady, across-the-board erosion of grammar and word meaning resembles the broad cognitive-linguistic decline of Alzheimer’s-type dementia (AD) ( Blennow et al., 2006 ) , reflecting an architecture in which grammar and meaning share a single recurrent pathway.
At heavier damage ( k ≥ 0.4 k\geq 0.4 ), because the 3-layer LSTM has no skip connections to bypass damaged layers, cumulative unit loss across the three layers reduces predictions to common function words (which still score hits on general text in Figures 2 a,b, but bring content-word Cloze scores to the zero floor by k = 0.4 ​ – ​ 0.6 k=0.4\text{--}0.6 ; Table 3 , rows 5–6; Tables 2 and 4 ).

与变形器不同的是,受损的LSTMs将其错误分布在常见和稀有的单词中,其比例大致与未受损模型(图3 a,b和4)相同,其语法和意义相关的Cloze分数在不分离的每个损害级别上一起下降(图5,第1行),在表2和补充表17中,全单位衰减降低了Cloze语法POS的匹配和语义共振的相似性,在轻度到中度的损伤中平行. 在AWD-LSTM中,POS比对和余弦相似度从57.0% 57.0\%和0.450 0.450未受损降至42.7% 42.7\%和0.322 0.322 = 0.2 k=0.2, 28.4% 28.4\%和0.203 = 0.3 k=0.3, 2.2% 2.2\%和0.020 = 0.5 k=0.5。 在小型LSTM中,它们从59.0%59.0\%和0.3370.337未受损下降到23.6%23.6\%和0.1770.177,在k=0.2k=0.2,11.4%11.4\%和0.0730.073在k=0.3k=0.3,在k=0.5k=0.5时0.0%和0.0000. 纵观轻度至中度损害(k 0.2 – 0.3 k\leq 0.2\text{-}0.3 ),语法和词义的这种平稳、全面的侵蚀类似于阿尔茨海默症类型痴呆症(AD)的广泛认知-语言下降(Blennow等人,2006年),反映了一种语法和含义具有单一的重复路径的架构。
在更重的损伤(k ^ 0.4 k\geq 0.4)时,由于3层LSTM没有跳过连接绕过受损的层,三层的累积单位损失将预测降低到常见的函数词(在图2 a,b中仍然在一般文本上得分,但将内容词Cloze的分数带至零下0.4 = 0.6 k=0.4\text{-}0.6;表3,第5-6行;表2和表4).

blocks.en:
Finally, we compare the mistake patterns of all four undamaged ( k = 0 k=0 ) and moderately damaged ( k = 0.2 k=0.2 ) models on the 100-prompt Cloze test against clinical naming data from 278 post-stroke aphasia patients ( Yang et al., 2026 ) using the Philadelphia Naming Test (PNT) error categories ( Roach et al., 1996 ; Mirman et al., 2010 ) (Figure 6 ; Supplementary Table 20 , Supplement S8 ).
This comparison yields two main findings.
First, a damaged model only resembles clinical aphasia if the undamaged model can already perform the task: at 20 % 20\% ablation, Qwen 1.8B matches the patient range in overall accuracy and blank responses while preserving its meaning-related mistakes, whereas the smaller LSTMs start well below the patient average and collapse into unrelated common words (Figure 6 a). 12 12 12 In Figure 6 a, 20 % 20\% unit ablation shifts Qwen 1.8B into an accuracy range ( 42.1 % 42.1\% MLP, 61.2 % 61.2\% attention) bracketing the 47.3 % 47.3\% patient mean when Correct includes top-5 predictions (first-response exact match is lower; Supplementary Table 20 ), while MLP No-response outputs (punctuation, digits, and, in bilingual Qwen models, occasional Chinese or byte-fallback tokens) rise to 18.1 % 18.1\% versus 21.9 % 21.9\% in patients. Second, across all seven PNT categories, the overall gap between the ablated model and the post-stroke patient profile drops sharply as model scale increases from the LSTMs to Qwen 1.8B (Figure 6 b).
blocks.zh:
最后,我们比较了所有四个未损坏(k = 0 k = 0)和中度损坏(k = 0.2 k = 0.2)模型在100瞬间上的错误模式. 使用费城命名测试(PNT)错误类别(Roach等人,1996年;Mirman等人,2010年)对278名中风后患(杨等人,2026年)的临床命名数据进行克隆测试(图6;补充表20,S8补编).
这一比较得出两个主要结论。
首先,如果未受损的模型已经能够完成任务,那么受损的模型就只能类似于临床上的厌食症:在20%的20%减速时,Quen 1.8B在总体准确度和空白反应中与患者范围相匹配,同时保留其与意义有关的错误,而较小的LSTMs则远远低于患者平均水平,崩溃成不相关的常见词(图6a、20%的20%减速将Quen 1.8B转换成准确范围(42.1%的MLP,61.2%的61.2%注意),将47.3%的47.3%的患者的平均值划入正确范围(第一反应准确的匹配率较低;补充表20),而MLP的无反应产出(在双语Quen模型中,偶有中文或字节倒数)则上升至18.1%,病人为21.9%。 其次,在所有7个PNT类别中,随着模型尺度从LSTMs增加到Qwen 1.8B(图6b),减速模型与中风后病人特征的总体差距急剧缩小。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en:
One hypothesis for the divergence between MLP and attention-head damage comes from their proposed roles inside a Transformer block.
Prior interpretability studies suggest that feedforward MLP layers act as distributed memory stores for specific word associations ( Geva et al., 2021 ) , whereas attention heads gather context from earlier words in the sentence ( Elhage et al., 2021 ; Olsson et al., 2022 ) along a shared skip-connection (residual) stream.
Under this hypothesis, damaging MLP neurons while leaving attention intact would allow sentence context to steer the model toward the right topic, while impairing its ability to retrieve the exact target word from memory.
This could explain why the MLP-damaged model continues to make same-category word substitutions at the undamaged rate before collapsing abruptly at k ∗ ≈ 0.3 ​ – ​ 0.4 k^{*}\approx 0.3\text{--}0.4 , partially paralleling Wernicke-type word-selection errors (though without preserved fluency, as blank and function-word outputs also rise) ( Wernicke, 1874 ; Goodglass, 1993 ) .
Conversely, damaging attention heads while leaving the MLP store intact would allow skip connections to preserve basic grammar and vocabulary access through moderate damage, while weakened sentence context could cause the model to fall back onto safer, more general words, resembling the loss of word specificity in svPPA ( Warrington, 1975 ; Hodges and Patterson, 2007 ; Gorno-Tempini et al., 2011 ; Lambon Ralph et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh:
MLP和注意力头损伤之间差异的一个假设来自它们在变形器块内的拟议角色.
先前的可解释性研究表明,向导的 MLP 层作为特定单词关联的分布式内存存储(Geva 等人, 2021年),而注意力头则从句子中较早的单词(Elhage等人, 2021年;Olsson等人, 2022年)沿共享的跳转(剩余)流收集上下文.
根据这一假设,在保持注意力的同时破坏MLP神经元,将使句子上下文能够引导模型向正确的话题发展,同时损害其从记忆中获取准确的目标词的能力.
这可以解释为什么MLP损坏的模型继续以未损坏的速度进行同一类词的替换,然后突然以k * 0.3 = 0.4 k = 0.4 = 0.3 k = 0.3\ text{-}0.4 ,部分平行于Wernicke类型的词选错误(虽然没有保留流利,但空白和函数字输出也上升)(Wernicke,1874;Goodglass,1993年)。
反之,在离开MLP商店完好无损的情况下,损坏的注意力头会允许跳过连接通过中度损伤来保留基本的语法和词汇访问,而句子上下文的弱化则会导致模型重新回到更安全,更泛泛的单词上,类似svPPA中字词特异性的丧失(Warrington,1975年;Hodges和Patterson,2007年;Gorno-Tempini等人,2011年;Lambon Ralph等人,2017年).

blocks.en:
These pathway-specific failure curves persist across all four post-damage fine-tuning regimes, indicating that architectural wiring, rather than short-term weight recovery, governs the shape of decline (Section 4 ; Supplement S9 ).
In clinical neurodegeneration such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD), overall test scores often stay near normal during a pre-symptomatic reserve phase despite substantial early entorhinal pathology and neuron loss ( Braak and Braak, 1991 ; Gómez-Isla et al., 1996 ) , before entering a symptomatic phase in which cortical synapse loss tracks steady cognitive decline ( DeKosky and Scheff, 1990 ; Terry et al., 1991 ) .
Our experiments show an analogous split between buffered early accuracy (under Transformer attention-head removal on the unit-fraction axis) and steady accuracy loss (under LSTM unit removal).
Crucially, however, even at mild damage ( k = 0.1 ​ – ​ 0.2 k=0.1\text{--}0.2 ), ablated models’ new mistakes already shift toward less common content words rather than ultra-common function words relative to an accuracy-matched random-failure baseline ( Δ ​ R 4 < 0 \Delta R_{4}<0 , Δ ​ D 1 > 0 \Delta D_{1}>0 ; significant from k = 0.1 k=0.1 in both LSTMs and Qwen MLP and from k = 0.2 k=0.2 in Qwen 1.8B attention; Figure 4 ).
Because modern disease-modifying therapies for AD ( van Dyck et al., 2023 ; Sims et al., 2023 ) require intervention before tau-driven cortical atrophy becomes widespread ( La Joie et al., 2020 ) , comparing patients’ word-frequency error patterns on naming or Cloze tests against an accuracy-matched random baseline could help distinguish early structural decline from benign attentional lapses before overall test scores fall.
blocks.zh:
这些专门针对路径的故障曲线在所有四个损坏后微调系统中持续存在,表明建筑线路而不是短期的重量恢复决定了下降的形状(第4节;S9号补编)。
在阿尔茨海默氏病(AD)等临床神经衰老中,总的测试分数在症状前保留阶段往往接近正常水平,尽管早期内脏病理学和神经丧失相当严重(Braak和Braak,1991年;Gómez-Isla等人,1996年),然后进入症状阶段,皮质突触损失跟踪认知持续下降(DeKosky和Scheff,1990年;Terry等人,1991年)。
我们的实验显示,缓冲早期精度(在单位折射轴上的变压器注意点清除下)和稳定精度损失(在LSTM单位清除下)之间有类似的分裂.
但重要的是,即使在轻度损害(k = 0.1 – 0.2 k=0.1\text{-}0.2 )时,与精确度匹配的随机故障基准相比,被推迟模型的新错误已经转向不太常见的内容单词,而不是超常见的功能单词(XQ R 4 < 0\Delta R_{4}<0,D 1 > 0\Delta D_{1}>0;在LSTMs和Quen MLP中从k = 0.1 k=0.1 k=0.1,在Quen 1.8B中从k = 0.2 k=0.2注意;图4)。
因为现代对AD(van Dyck等人,2023年;Sims等人,2023年)的疾病修饰疗法需要在tau驱动的皮质萎缩病变普遍之前进行干预(La Joie等人,2020年),将患者命名或克洛泽测试的词频误差模式与精度匹配的随机基线进行比较,有助于在总体测试分数下降前区分早期结构衰减和良性注意力缺失.

blocks.en:
In contrast to the Transformer, both the Small LSTM and the much larger AWD-LSTM pass information through a single chain of three recurrent layers without separate MLP and attention sub-blocks or skip connections.
Making the LSTM larger raises its undamaged accuracy ( 27.5 % 27.5\% to 38.1 % 38.1\% ), but does not change its failure pattern: next-word accuracy declines smoothly across the entire ablation range (Figures 2 a,b), and on the Cloze test grammar and word meaning erode steadily together from k = 0.1 k=0.1 until reaching the zero floor on content words by k = 0.4 ​ – ​ 0.6 k=0.4\text{--}0.6 , where the models fall back to common function words (Figure 5 , row 1).
Our supplementary experiments that cut specific types of LSTM connections one at a time (Section 4 ; Supplements S2 – S6 ) explain both aspects of this profile: cutting only the memory links from earlier words causes a slow, steady co-decline of grammar and meaning across the full range, whereas cutting the links that feed the current word up the three-layer chain causes a rapid drop onto function-word defaults once enough serial capacity is lost.
blocks.zh:
与变形器形成对比的是,小LSTM和更大的AWD-LSTM都通过由三个反复层组成的单一链路传递信息,没有单独的MLP和注意力子块或跳过连接.
使LSTM更大提高了它的无损精度(27.5%-27.5%-至38.1%-38.1%),但并未改变它的故障模式:下字精度在整个衰竭范围顺利下降(图2 a,b),在克洛兹测试语法和词义上,从k=0.1 k=0.1一起稳步侵蚀,直到以k=0.4=0.6 k=0.4\text{-}0.6在内容词上达到零下,模型回到共同功能词(图5,第1行)。
我们的补充实验一次剪切特定类型的LSTM连接(第4节;补充S2 – S6),解释这个剖面图的两方面: 仅剪切早期单词的内存链接会导致语法和含义在全程范围缓慢,稳定的共解,而将当前单词反馈到三层链上的链条则导致一旦失去足够的串行能力,就会迅速下降到函数字默认值上.

blocks.en:
Three main limitations qualify our conclusions.
First, uniform binary neuron zeroing across all layers captures only one idealised mode of neural damage.
Real brain disease and stroke can damage circuits in many other ways, including gradual synapse weakening and noisy signalling before cell death ( Blennow et al., 2006 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , damage concentrated in specific layers or regions rather than spread evenly across layers ( Braak and Braak, 1991 ; Moore et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , broken connections between regions, and brain recovery mechanisms that differ from standard model fine-tuning ( Moore et al., 2023a ; Moore et al., 2023b ) .
Accordingly, our clinical parallels describe output-level behavioural analogies rather than one-to-one mappings onto the neurocognitive components of controlled semantic cognition ( Jefferies and Lambon Ralph, 2006 ; Lambon Ralph et al., 2017 ; Robson et al., 2012 ) .
Second, our empirical scope is bounded by model scale, training corpus, and prompt sample size. The LSTMs ( ∼ 10 {\sim}10 – 44 44 M parameters, trained on WikiText) and Transformers ( 0.6 0.6 – 1.8 1.8 B parameters, evaluated on TinyStories) differ in size, corpus, and tokeniser (Supplement S2 ). In addition, while our 100-prompt Cloze battery clearly separates the overall degradation curves of the MLP and attention pathways, larger prompt batteries will be needed to test fine-grained differences between pathways in individual error subtypes (Supplement S6 ).
Third, single-word Cloze completions over a fixed text vocabulary isolate word-choice errors (Semantic, Unrelated, and No-response) but cannot reproduce spoken-sound slips or made-up non-words (Formal, Mixed, and Neologism ≤ 1 % {\leq}1\% vs. ≈ 20.5 % {\approx}20.5\% in patients ( Roach et al., 1996 ; Mirman et al., 2010 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) ) because the models lack a speech-production stage; they also do not assess sentence-level fluency or pragmatics. Moreover, automated scoring depends on operational rules (top-5 accuracy matching, POS-gated GloVe similarity, and WordNet/CMUdict thresholds; Supplements S7 – S8 ) on open-ended prompts that admit multiple valid continuations. Extending these analyses to larger models and connected patient speech from AphasiaBank ( MacWhinney et al., 2011 ) is an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的结论有三个主要限制。
首先,统一的二元神经元在所有层间零化,只捕捉到一种理想的神经损伤模式.
真正的脑病和中风可以以许多其他方式破坏电路,包括:在细胞死亡前逐渐发生突触减弱和发出噪音信号(Blennow等人,2006年;Yang等人,2026年),损害集中在特定层或区域,而不是在层间平均分布(Braak and Braak,1991年;Moore等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年),区域间断裂连接,以及不同于标准模型微调的大脑恢复机制(Moore等人,2023a;Moore等人,2023b).
因此,我们的临床平行描述的是输出级的行为类比,而不是对受控语义认知的神经认知成分进行一对一的映射(Jefferies and Lambon Ralph, 2006;Lambon Ralph等人, 2017;Robson等人, 2012)。
第二,我们的经验范围以模型规模、培训大纲和快速样本规模为界。 LSTMs( 10 {\sim}10 – 44 44 M参数,在维基文库中训练)和变形金刚(0.6 – 1.8 B参数,在小结构上评价)在体积,体积,体积和体质(补充S2)上都有所不同. 此外,虽然我们的100瞬间Cloze电池显然将MLP的整体降解曲线和注意力路径分开,但需要更大的快速电池来测试单个误差子类型(补充S6)的路径之间的细微差别.
第三,单词Cloze在固定文本词汇上完成将单词选择错误(Semantic,无关系和无反应)隔离开来,但不能复制口音滑音或编造非词(Formal, Mixed, and Neologism 1% ~leq}1\% vs. ~20.5% ~约}20.5\%)在患者中(Roach等人,1996年;Mirman等人,2010年;Yang等人,2026年),因为模型缺乏语音制作阶段;他们也不评估句子层次的流利或实用性. 此外,自动积分取决于操作规则(Top-5精度匹配,POS-gated GloVe相似性,以及WordNet/CMUdict阈值;补充S7 – S8)取决于允许多个有效续作的开放式提示. 将这些分析扩展至更大的模型和来自AphasiaBank的连接病人的演讲(MacWhinney等人,2011年)是未来工作的一个重要方向.

blocks.en: Full architectural specifications, weight-matrix indexing equations, hyperparameter schedules, and scoring algorithms are provided in Extended Materials and Methods (Supplement S1 ; schematic overview in Supplementary Figure 7 ).

blocks.en:
We evaluate four autoregressive language models spanning two architecture families: a 3-layer Small LSTM ( ∼ 10 {\sim}10 M parameters) trained from scratch, a pretrained 3-layer AWD-LSTM ( ∼ 44 {\sim}44 M parameters) ( Merity et al., 2018 ; Howard and Ruder, 2018 ) , and two 24-layer pretrained Transformers, Qwen 1.5-0.5B ( ∼ 620 {\sim}620 M parameters) and Qwen 1.5-1.8B ( 1.8 1.8 B parameters) ( Bai et al., 2023 ) . Full layer dimensions, non-embedding parameter counts, and pretraining details are listed in Table 1 and Supplement S1 .
In our six primary unit-level conditions, ablating a fraction k ∈ { 0.0 , 0.1 , … , 0.9 } k\in\{0.0,0.1,\ldots,0.9\} per layer completely silences ⌊ k × n ⌋ \lfloor k\times n\rfloor randomly selected units in every layer (Supplementary Figure 7 ).
First, LSTM whole-unit removal zeroes all incoming and outgoing weights and gate biases of the selected hidden units across both the input-to-hidden and recurrent hidden-to-hidden pathways (removing 70.4 % 70.4\% and 72.7 % 72.7\% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 in the Small LSTM and AWD-LSTM).
Second, Transformer MLP neuron removal zeroes the input and output projections of the selected intermediate feedforward neurons ( 33.7 % 33.7\% and 33.4 % 33.4\% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ).
Third, Transformer attention-head removal zeroes the query, key, value, and output projections (and biases) of the selected attention heads ( 16.3 % 16.3\% and 16.6 % 16.6\% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 , in discrete steps of 1 / 16 1/16 corresponding to the 16 heads per layer).
To separate the two incoming LSTM pathways, we also run two connection-level controls across both LSTMs: recurrent-connection pruning , which zeroes only the hidden-to-hidden weights and gate biases of selected units ( 37.4 % 37.4\% and 41.7 % 41.7\% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ), and input-connection pruning , which zeroes only their input-to-hidden weights and gate biases ( 25.0 % 25.0\% and 22.2 % 22.2\% at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ).

We run 5 5 independent random-seed trials per k ∈ { 0.0 , 0.1 , … , 0.9 } k\in\{0.0,\allowbreak 0.1,\allowbreak\ldots,\allowbreak 0.9\} for all unit- and connection-level conditions, increasing replication to 15 15 trials per k k across k ∈ { 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.3 , 0.4 } k\in\{0.1,\allowbreak 0.2,\allowbreak 0.3,\allowbreak 0.4\} ( n = 60 n=60 trials per pathway) for the Qwen null-model tests (Section 2.3 ) and 10 10 trials at k = 0.2 k=0.2 ( N = 1,000 N=1{,}000 prompt evaluations per condition) for the Cloze, concreteness, and PNT analyses (Section 2.5 ).
In each trial, ablated weights and biases are zeroed and kept frozen at zero during a brief stochastic gradient descent (SGD) pass ( lr = 10 − 3 \mathrm{lr}=10^{-3} , gradient clipping 0.25 0.25 ) that models limited local recovery ( 40 40 and 50 50 sequence steps for the Small LSTM and AWD-LSTM; 62 62 weight updates across 500 500 TinyStories passages for Qwen).
Sensitivity controls comparing zero fine-tuning, brief local SGD, and 500-step AdamW retraining are reported in Supplement S9 .

For Qwen, they are evaluated on 500 500 held-out TinyStories passages ( Eldan and Li, 2023 ) truncated to 32 32 tokens (up to 31 31 next-token predictions per passage), and all curves are reported as relative accuracy RelAcc ⁡ ( k ) = Acc ⁡ ( k ) / Acc ⁡ ( 0 ) \mathrm{RelAcc}(k)=\mathrm{Acc}(k)/\mathrm{Acc}(0) . Syntactic and semantic degradation are evaluated on a shared 100-prompt Cloze battery (48 nouns, 25 verbs, 22 adjectives, 5 adverbs) using part-of-speech (POS) match on the top-1 predicted word (tagged in isolation via NLTK ( Bird et al., 2009 ) ) and 50-dimensional GloVe ( Pennington et al., 2014 ) cosine similarity (set to zero for non-content predictions). blocks.en:
This supplement is organized into three parts so that all methodological details and quantitative analyses appear before the archival prompt-level lookup tables.
First, Section S1 ( Extended Materials and Methods ) provides the complete architectural specifications, weight-matrix ablation definitions (Supplementary Figure 7 ), post-lesion fine-tuning protocols, and metric implementations.
Second, Sections S2 – S9 present the supporting quantitative analyses and sensitivity controls: parameter-fraction scaling, curve-shape model selection, and LSTM connection-pruning controls (Section S2 ); R 4 R_{4} scale-invariance derivation and accuracy-matched null-model breakdowns (Section S3 ); frequency-rank Fourier spectral analysis and complete per- k k metric tables (Section S4 ); quantitative Cloze trajectories and qualitative cross-model comparison (Section S5 ); statistical formalisation of the clinical parallel assignments (Section S6 ); Brysbaert concreteness scoring methodology (Section S7 ); automated re-coding into the seven-category Philadelphia Naming Test (PNT) taxonomy and patient cohort comparisons (Section S8 ); and four-arm compensatory plasticity sensitivity controls across zero, local SGD, and 500-step AdamW fine-tuning (Section S9 ).
Third, Sections S10 – S13 at the end of the supplement archive the complete 100-prompt first-trial Cloze predictions across all undamaged and ablated conditions for Qwen 1.8B, Qwen 0.5B, AWD-LSTM, and Small LSTM for completeness and reproducibility.

第二,S2节-S9节提出了辅助性定量分析和敏感性控制:参数折射、曲线形状模型选择和LSTM连接推算控制(S2节);R 4 R_{4}比例波动推算和精度匹配的无效模型分解(S3节);频率等级Fourier光谱分析和每千公尺表的完整(S4节);定量克洛兹轨迹和定性跨模型比较(S5节);临床平行任务的统计正规化(S6节);Brysbaert混凝土评分法(S7节);七类费城纳明测试分类和病人组别比较(S8节);全零、局部SGD和500步AdamW微调(S9节)。
第三,S10 – S13节在补编结尾处归档了完整的100个即时一审克洛泽预测,涵盖Quen 1.8B,Quen 0.5B,AWD-LSTM,以及小LSTM等所有未损坏和减速条件,以了解完整性和可复制性.

blocks.en: Figure 7 illustrates the computational pathways and ablation modes evaluated across the recurrent (LSTM) and Transformer model families. In each LSTM layer, every hidden unit receives two incoming linear projections that sum across its four gates (input, forget, cell, and output): an input-to-hidden weight matrix ( weight_ih , with gate bias bias_ih ) that projects the current-step input x t x_{t} from the embedding or preceding layer, and a recurrent hidden-to-hidden weight matrix ( weight_hh , with gate bias bias_hh ) that projects the previous hidden state h t − 1 h_{t-1} (Figure 7 a).
blocks.zh: 图7说明了整个经常系统(LSTM)和变形器模型家庭所评价的计算路径和计算模式。 在每层LSTM中,每个隐藏单元都会收到两个接进的线性预测,总和跨越其四个门(输入,遗忘,单元格和输出):一个输入到隐藏的重量矩阵(重量_ih,带有闸门偏差_ih),从嵌入层或前层中预测当前步骤输入 x t x_{t},以及一个经常性的隐藏到隐藏的重量矩阵(重量_hhh,带有闸门偏差_hhh),以预测以前的隐藏状态 h t− 1 h_{t-1}(图7 a).

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Schematic overview of model architectures and ablation modes. (a) In the 3-layer Small LSTM and pretrained AWD-LSTM (serial layer stack without residual skip connections), our primary target is whole-unit removal (left card), which zeroes weight_ih rows, weight_hh incoming rows and outgoing columns, gate biases bias_ih and bias_hh , and outgoing columns in the next layer’s weight_ih to silence unit j j completely ( h t , j ≡ 0 h_{t,j}\equiv 0 ). To separate the two incoming pathways (Section 3 ; Supplements S2 – S6 ), we also evaluate two connection-level controls: recurrent-connection pruning (centre card), which zeroes weight_hh rows/columns and gate biases while unit j j still receives current input x t x_{t} , and input-connection pruning (right card), which zeroes weight_ih rows and gate biases while unit j j still receives recurrent state h t − 1 h_{t-1} . (b) In the 24-layer Qwen 0.5B and Qwen 1.8B Transformers, a residual stream ( + + ) bypasses each layer’s attention and MLP sub-blocks. We compare (1) attention-head removal ( Q , K , V Q,K,V projection rows/biases and O O projection columns zeroed) and (2) MLP neuron removal ( up_proj / gate_proj rows and down_proj columns zeroed).

blocks.en:
This model is a 3-layer LSTM with 155-dimensional embeddings and hidden states, a tied decoder sharing encoder embedding weights, and dropout 0.2.
It is trained from scratch on the WikiText-103 training split [ Merity et al., 2017 ] for 10 epochs with the Adam optimizer [ Kingma and Ba, 2015 ] . Text is tokenized with lowercased word and punctuation splitting mapped to the shared 60,000 60{,}000 -token AWD-LSTM vocabulary, using xxunk for out-of-vocabulary words without xxbos / xxmaj / xxup prefix tokens.
Across all 3 layers simultaneously, we evaluate complete whole-unit removal alongside two incomplete (connection-level) controls discussed in Section 3 and reported in the Supplement, defined in terms of the input-to-hidden matrix weight_ih and recurrent hidden-to-hidden matrix weight_hh (Figure 7 a): 1. Whole-unit removal ( weight_ih + weight_hh ): For each selected unit index j j , we zero rows [ g ⋅ H + j , : ] [g\cdot H+j,:] of both weight_ih and weight_hh across all four gates ( g ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } g\in\{0,1,2,3\} , where g g indexes the four stacked LSTM gates: input, forget, cell, and output, each of height H H ). We simultaneously zero columns [ : , j ] [:,j] of weight_hh , columns [ : , j ] [:,j] of the next layer’s weight_ih (for layers ℓ < L − 1 \ell<L-1 ), and the corresponding entries of bias_ih and bias_hh . This completely silences unit j j ( h t , j ≡ 0 h_{t,j}\equiv 0 , verified by forward hooks showing max ⁡ | activity | = 0.0 \max|\text{activity}|=0.0 ) and removes 408,408 408{,}408 parameters, or 70.4% of non-embedding parameters, at k = 0.5 k=0.5 . 2. Recurrent-connection pruning (incomplete ablation control 1; weight_hh ): We zero rows [ g ⋅ H + j , : ] [g\cdot H+j,:] (incoming recurrent) and columns [ : , j ] [:,j] (outgoing recurrent) of weight_hh , together with the corresponding gate entries of bias_ih and bias_hh , across all four gates. This leaves weight_ih and next-layer projections intact so unit j j can still be driven by x t x_{t} (removing 37.4% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ). 3. Input-connection pruning (incomplete ablation control 2; weight_ih ): We zero rows [ g ⋅ H + j , : ] [g\cdot H+j,:] of weight_ih and the corresponding gate entries of bias_ih and bias_hh across all four gates, leaving weight_hh intact (removing 25.0% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ). Gradient hooks maintain all ablated entries at zero during fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
这个模型是3层的LSTM,具有155维嵌入和隐藏状态,绑定的解码器共享编码器嵌入权重,并退出0.2.
它从零开始在WikiText-103训练分裂[Merity et al., 2017]上接受训练,为10个带有亚当优化器的时代[Kingma and Ba, 2015]. 文本以小写字和 punctuation 分隔为6万60{,} 000 -token AWD-LSTM 词汇,使用 xxunk 表示省外字,没有 xxbos / xxmaj / xxup 前缀符号。

blocks.en:
This model is a 3-layer Average Stochastic Gradient Descent Weight-Dropped LSTM (AWD-LSTM) [ Merity et al., 2018 ] with 400-dimensional embeddings, 1,152 hidden units in the first two layers, 400 in the third, and a tied decoder.
It uses WeightDrop [ Merity et al., 2018 ] with w drop = 0.5 w_{\mathrm{drop}}=0.5 during training. At ablation time, we disable WeightDrop ( w drop → 0 w_{\mathrm{drop}}\to 0 ) so that dropout-trained resilience does not mask ablation effects.
Pretrained weights are loaded from fastai [ Howard and Ruder, 2018 ] trained on WikiText-103, sharing the exact 60,000 60{,}000 -token vocabulary of the Small LSTM.
We evaluate the same three lesion types as for the Small LSTM (Figure 7 a): 1. Whole-unit removal : Zeroes weight_ih , weight_hh , gate biases, and next-layer weight_ih columns, completely silencing ablated units ( max ⁡ | activity | = 0.0 \max|\text{activity}|=0.0 ) and removing 14,738,752 14{,}738{,}752 parameters (72.7% of non-embedding parameters) at k = 0.5 k=0.5 . 2. Recurrent-connection pruning (incomplete control 1): Zeroes the recurrent weight matrix weight_hh and gate biases (41.7% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ). 3. Input-connection pruning (incomplete control 2): Zeroes weight_ih plus gate biases (22.2% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ).

blocks.en:
Qwen 1.5-0.5B [ Bai et al., 2023 ] is loaded from its off-the-shelf pretrained checkpoint ( Qwen/Qwen1.5-0.5B ) and is a dense Transformer with SwiGLU MLP activations, RoPE positional embeddings, and multi-head attention (24 layers; hidden size 1,024; MLP intermediate size 2,816; 16 query heads and 16 key–value heads).
We evaluate two ablation targets across all 24 layers. First, MLP neuron removal zeroes rows of the bias-free up_proj and gate_proj matrices and columns of the bias-free down_proj matrix ( max ⁡ | activity | = 0.0 \max|\text{activity}|=0.0 ; removing 33.7% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ). Second, attention-head removal zeroes Q Q , K K , V V projection rows (and their additive biases) and the bias-free O O projection columns for selected heads ( max ⁡ | activity | = 0.0 \max|\text{activity}|=0.0 ; removing 16.3% of non-embedding parameters at k = 0.5 k=0.5 ).
The two targets differ in granularity: each layer contains 2,816 2{,}816 MLP neurons ( 5,504 5{,}504 in Qwen 1.8B) but only 16 16 attention heads. Because attention ablation removes ⌊ 16 ​ k ⌋ \lfloor 16\,k\rfloor whole heads per layer, the removed head fraction increases in steps of 1 / 16 1/16 ( 6.25 % 6.25\% ) and is slightly below k k when 16 ​ k 16\,k is not an integer (for example, k = 0.3 k=0.3 removes 4 4 of 16 16 heads, or 25 % 25\% of heads and 8.2 % 8.2\% of non-embedding parameters). To account for both discrete head counts and pathway parameter size, Supplementary Figure 9 and Supplementary Table 6 plot and fit degradation curves against both k k and the exact fraction of non-embedding parameters removed.
